newsitem.title: UK: ATHLETICS-MUTOLA WITHDRAWS AFTER DEATH OF FATHER.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-MUTOLA WITHDRAWS AFTER DEATH OF FATHER.

text.p: World indoor 800 metres champion Maria Mutola has withdrawn from Sunday's Birmingham indoor grand prix following the death of her father in a car accident on Friday.

British Athletic Federation promotions officer Ian Stewart said on Sunday the former outdoor world champion had learned on Saturday that her father had been killed in a car crash in Mozambique on the previous day.
Sweden's former world high jump champion Patrik Sjoeberg has also withdrawn from the meeting after he was assaulted in a Stockholm nightclub.
Stewart said that according to local newspaper reports Sjoeberg had been attacked with a broken glass.
